exposure: Women with spontaneous tears or episiotomy
finding: UI prevalence was 24.3% in the third trimester and 12.6% at 6 months postpartum, while FI prevalence was 6.2% and 4.2% respectively; risk factors for UI included older age, higher education, overweight/obesity, and spontaneous tears/episiotomy, while cesarean section and pelvic floor muscle training were protective.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was protective against postpartum UI, while spontaneous tears or episiotomy were risk factors for postpartum UI.
